newsitem.title: USA: U.S. muni bond insurers post record 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: U.S. muni bond insurers post record 1996 results.

text.p: The Association of Financial Guaranty Insurors (AFGI), whose members insure or reinsure municipal bonds and structured asset-backed securities, said Wednesday that 1996 combined net income rose by 19 percent to a record $875 million.
AFGI said its qualified statutory capital rose to a record $7.4 billion, up 14 percent from 1995.
"AFGI's growth in net income, which contributes significantly to our ability to build claims-paying capital, underscores the industry's financial strength," said AFGI Chairman James Malling.

The association, which insures almost half of all new municipal bonds, said strong investor demand for insured securities propelled insured penetration to record levels in both the municipal and asset-backed markets.

"AFGI expects continued robust demand for financial guaranty insurance, in both domestic and international markets, as investors seek added safety and issuers utilize AFGI firms' AAA ratings to reduce their borrowing costs," Malling said.
AFGI firms insured a record $172.4 billion in par value of municipal bonds and structured asset-backed financings, up 38 percent over 1995.
